bio: Dame Gruev was a teacher from Smilevo, near Bitola, and one of the founders of the Macedonian Revolutionary Organisation in Thessaloniki in 1893. He built its network of committees village by village and was one of the leaders of the Ilinden Uprising in 1903. He was killed fighting Ottoman troops near Rusinovo in December 1906, and is remembered as one of the fathers of the Macedonian liberation movement.
